summary: Master mobile disaster management. Learn ODK, KoboToolbox, and geospatial tools for emergency response. Enhance field data collection and situational awareness.
lede: Mobile disaster management training helps emergency and humanitarian professionals turn field observations into usable information during crises. Designed for people coordinating or carrying out field operations, it covers collecting and synchronizing data offline, mapping damage with geospatial tools, and verifying crowdsourced reports. Learners also practice building rapid needs assessment forms, configuring team-safety geofencing, and connecting mobile data to response dashboards while considering privacy and limited power.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is tailored for professionals who manage or execute field operations during humanitarian crises and emergency events.
audience: Search and Rescue Technicians using mobile geospatial
modules: Crowdsourcing and Crisis Mapping with Ushahidi
Data Privacy, Security, and Offline Resilience
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the disaster management cycle (Mitigation, Preparedness, Response, Recovery). No prior coding experience is required, but familiarity with Microsoft Excel for form design and basic GIS concepts is highly recommended. Participants must bring a laptop and an Android-based mobile device for hands-on technical exercises.
